featured_reviews.name: Priya Maurya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely loved my experience here! 🌟

I tried the white sauce pasta and a mixed berries smoothie, and honestly—both were out of this world. The pasta was everything you dream of: luxuriously creamy, perfectly cheesy, and cooked just right—neither dry nor soggy. Every bite felt rich, comforting, and indulgent in the best possible way.

And then came the smoothie… wow. This was my first time having dry fruits in a mixed berries smoothie, and I didn’t know what I was missing. It was incredibly refreshing, energizing, and so awakening that words genuinely fall short. It felt less like a drink and more like a boost of pure goodness and happiness in a glass.

If you’re someone who appreciates thoughtful flavors and quality that truly stands out, this cafe is a must-visit. Can’t wait to come back and explore more! ☕✨

featured_reviews.name: Pranav Amale
featured_reviews.review_text:
There used to be a great Cold Coco stall opposite of this, but it was closed at the time, so we had to make do.

Had a couple of milkshakes and faloodas with friends.
I'd say don't try anything fancy. The basic chocolate was 4/5.
The faloodas had weird consistencies. It was like a watered down milkshake mixed with other falooda stuff like nuts, berries, sooji etc., so 3/5.
Then one of us had Mango Maharaja, and it was possibly the only mango dish I would never order again. The red cherry on top was sour and had a weird aftertaste(like if you put something in a fridge open for a few days) and the mangoes were a little sour as well(We went close to April, so it was in season as well). 2/5. Edible, but get something else.

Also, make sure to remind the guys that take your order occasionally, since the store forgot a part of our order twice(there's often a lot of rush)

featured_reviews.name: Khushal Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: As I have tried Think juice earlier in south mumbai, I ordered the same Belgian choco chip thick shake.This is still the best thick shake I had in my life. The texture of the cake pieces is so fine, plus the choco chips add a whole different taste. A must try for everyone. Its really amazing guys, cannot believe the that prices are so cheap compared to others, such an amazing quality and packaging.

review_photos.caption: Belgian choco chip thick shake and fresh lime

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Pandhre
featured_reviews.review_text: I had tried many outlets of think juice, but this one was not that good ,  I had tried many thickshake here but everytime I get less flavour, less milk it tastes only ice water nothing else

featured_reviews.name: Hitesh Verma
featured_reviews.review_text: Shakes are good but the quality keeps changing, now there is lot of dirt here, lot of flies inside and outside this place which makes it dangerous for anyone, it seems like no one pays attention to cleanliness now....

featured_reviews.name: ADITEE PANDIT
featured_reviews.review_text:
We ordered fresh lime juice and it took a lot more time than it should take . When we asked why is it taking so long then the guy at the billing counter replied we rinse the mixer for fresh lime that's why I don't like taking orders for fresh lime😒😒 he could have handle the situation politely but he didn't. If you don't like taking orders for that then why is it there in your menu?

As a customer we are paying for beverage and a service not for attitude

featured_reviews.review_text: Tried the Hopscotch Butterscotch shake — total disappointment. Absolutely no trace of butterscotch flavour, just a bland, overpriced drink. Not worth ₹130 at all. Quality needs serious improvement.

featured_reviews.name: Amol Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text: Dear people!! This is one of the oldest restaurant and juice centre near Bomaby hospital Marines lines and I had been visiting this place from last more than 20years.. Over the time it has degraded the quality of food and juices and also the hygeine level is very poor. The cooks and people making jucice sandwitches are not following basic cleanliness and hygiene and they charge very costly for all items on name of being oldest restaurant. The cooks doesnt even wear basic gloves at time of any preparations of juice, pab bhaji or sandwitches. They use dirty hands and clothes in cooking area. I strictly advise not to buy any stuffs for patient admitted in hospital as the quality and hygiene issues can lead to severe other health problems for patients admitted in hospital.

featured_reviews.name: Saurabh Panshikar
featured_reviews.review_text: The place is located just next to Bombay hospital. They have such a strict "no outside food" policy they didn't even allow a patient to have his tiffin even though the other family member ordered from the restaurant. The staff also behaved rudely.

featured_reviews.name: Anjali Mer
featured_reviews.review_text:
We ordered cold coffee, grape blossom, strawberry milkshake, and pineapple blossom

The cold coffee was only for Rs 30.
It was nice and strong. Completely gives the kick.

The grape blossom was a rich blend of thick grape juice and ice cream scooped on the top.
Blossom usually contains icecream blended in but we requested in on the top.

Strawberry milkshake was amazing. The original taste of strawberry was preserved. It was thick to enjoy with lots of strawberry pieces.

Pineapple blossom was a nice pineapple juice with vanilla ice cream scooped on the top

Our total came to around Rs 260. It's a good juice spot. I have tried others in the area but this is definitely better.

featured_reviews.name: Sarang Vakharia
featured_reviews.review_text: Highly recommend ppl to visit, best fresh natural juice, no mixing, i recommend 4 berry juice. Its my every weekend spot

featured_reviews.name: Chandresh Vk
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is at Kalbadevi just next to Edward theatre. The variety of juices, shake and cream item is good. After dinner it's preferable to visit specially, although its open more then 10 hrs a day. My favourite is mint lime sweat and salty very light and tasty apart there are many good option available. Try it 👍

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Sane
featured_reviews.review_text: It's another great juice centre in the area. The juices and shakes are moderately priced. The mint lemon cooler is a personal favourite. It's extremely refreshing. Another one is the Oreo shake, a dallop of ice cream can be added on to the Oreo shake.

featured_reviews.name: Mustafa Vakil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Best juice in Mumbai
Specially 4 berries juice

featured_reviews.name: Yahya Baker
featured_reviews.review_text: Great juice and milkshake place. A wide variety of options are available on the menu. And their chocolate variants....MUAH! Amazing taste! Tho the sweetness might be much for people who take less sugar and sweet stuff in their diet. Otherwise, great place. Only two wheeler parking as it's located on a busy road.

featured_reviews.name: mustansir rangwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
Natural juice centre is not natural they load their juices and milkshakes with sugar . Heaps of sugar are put into your drinks which would make your juice or milkshake sweet and if it's sweet you have to like it.

I had ordered Nutella Milkshake was ok expected it to be sweet and was fair as per the drink and I ordered plain chocolate milkshake specifying no added sugar still it turned out to be super sweet and after arguing the juice maker admitted that he had put sugar in it plus loads of chocolate syrup making it even worst.

The owner was rude and il mannered. when I told him about the sweetness he refused to take the feedback and straight away dipped his finger into my glass to taste while i was carrying the glass. He refused to accept that the quantity of the sugar was more masking the taste of the drink. After arguing in front of his other customers he admitted and gave another milkshake without sugar which was little better.

Request people to stay away from these artificial scam making juice centre stating being natural they are just here to make money and don't care for peoples health.

featured_reviews.name: Mohammed Chinikamwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is one of the best juice parlours in sobo .
The owner is super friendly and the quality and price for juice is just amazing . We are regular visitors to this place and would recommend you try the lemon mint soda and the 2 berry blossom
